splatUrl.name: splatUrl
splatUrl.description:
Streamed LOD URL.
This should be your lod-meta.json link.

environmentUrl.name: environmentUrl
environmentUrl.description:
Optional environment URL.
This is only loaded in Streamed LOD mode.

highSplatUrl.name: highSplatUrl
highSplatUrl.description:
High quality URL.
This should be your single full-quality .sog file.

streamedLodBaseDistance.name: streamedLodBaseDistance
streamedLodBaseDistance.description: Distance where Streamed LOD starts changing from higher detail to lower detail.

streamedLodMultiplier.name: streamedLodMultiplier
streamedLodMultiplier.description: Controls how quickly the LOD distance increases.

streamedLodRange.name: streamedLodRange
streamedLodRange.description:
LOD range for the Streamed LOD file.

For your current Fungi Room LOD, use [0, 3].

delay.name: delay
delay.description: Time offset before lift wave starts (seconds)

waveTint.name: waveTint
waveTint.description: Additive color for lift wave highlight

endRadius.name: endRadius
endRadius.description: Distance at which to disable effect for performance

bandWidth.name: bandWidth
bandWidth.description: Width of the color bands for dot and lift waves

annotationCount.title: Annotation Count
annotationCount.description: Number of editable annotation slots used below.

annotationsJson.title: Raw Backup JSON
annotationsJson.description: Backup copy. The numbered fields below are used first by the runtime.

annotationsAsset.title: Fallback Annotations Asset
annotationsAsset.description: Used only if the editable fields and Raw Backup JSON are empty.
